articles.summary: State-of-the-art convening space will connect the public to thought leaders in science, technology and innovation at one of New England’s most attended cultural institutions Eastern Bank is pleased to announce tax-exempt bond financing for the William and Charlotte Bloomberg Public Science Common at the Museum of Science in Boston, a new 10,000-square foot civic venue designed to inspire lifelong engagement with science by sparking discourse and discovery through immersive experiences. With floor-to-ceiling glass overlooking the Charles River and 270-degree views of the Boston skyline, the William and Charlotte Bloomberg Public Science Common complements its civic mission with state-of-the-art immersive media, production, and livestreaming technology that enables events to reach audiences around the world. articles.title: Eastern Bank Provides Tax-Exempt Bond Financing For the William and Charlotte Bloomberg Public Science Common at the Museum of Science
